title: Factored form & writing equations交点式与求解析式

quiz.q: What is the vertex of y=−2(x+1)(x−5)?y=−2(x+1)(x−5) 的顶点是什么？
opts: (2,−9)
(−2,−14)
(2,18)
(−1,5)
quiz.hint: Midpoint of the zeros, then substitute into the given form.取零点中点，再代入原式。
quiz.why: Correct: zeros −1,5, axis x=2, y=−2(3)(−3)=18.正确：零点 −1,5，对称轴 x=2，y=−2(3)(−3)=18。
whys: Dropped a=−2 when substituting x=2: (3)(−3)=−9 must still be multiplied by −2.代入 x=2 时丢了 a=−2：(3)(−3)=−9 还要乘 −2。
Read the zeros as 1 and −5 (bracket signs not flipped), so the axis came out −2.零点读成 1 和 −5（括号符号没反过来），对称轴错成 −2。
Correct: zeros −1,5, axis x=2, y=−2(3)(−3)=18.正确：零点 −1,5，对称轴 x=2，y=−2(3)(−3)=18。
Took the numbers in the brackets as a point; they give zeros, not the vertex.把括号里的数当成一个点；它们给的是零点，不是顶点。

quiz.q: A parabola has x-intercepts 1 and 5 and passes through (3,−8). In standard form it is:抛物线的 x 截距为 1 和 5，且过 (3,−8)。它的一般式是：
opts: y=x2−6x+5
y=2x2−12x+10
y=2x2+12x+10
y=−2x2+12x−10
quiz.hint: Zeros give the brackets; the point gives a.零点给括号，点给 a。
quiz.why: Correct: −8=a(2)(−2), a=2; 2(x−1)(x−5)=2x2−12x+10.正确：−8=a(2)(−2)，a=2；2(x−1)(x−5)=2x2−12x+10。
whys: Forgot a: (x−1)(x−5) gives −4 at x=3, not −8.忘了 a：(x−1)(x−5) 在 x=3 处是 −4，不是 −8。
Correct: −8=a(2)(−2), a=2; 2(x−1)(x−5)=2x2−12x+10.正确：−8=a(2)(−2)，a=2；2(x−1)(x−5)=2x2−12x+10。
Wrote (x+1)(x+5): those brackets give zeros −1 and −5.写成 (x+1)(x+5)：这样零点是 −1 和 −5。
Sign of a wrong: (2)(−2)=−4, so a=−4−8​=+2.a 的符号错：(2)(−2)=−4，a=−4−8​=+2。

quiz.q: State the x-intercepts and axis of symmetry of y=−3(x−2)(x+6).写出 y=−3(x−2)(x+6) 的 x 截距和对称轴。
quiz.hint: Midpoint of 2 and −6.2 和 −6 的中点。
quiz.ans: intercepts 2 and −6; axis x=−2截距 2 和 −6；对称轴 x=−2
quiz.why: x=2, x=−6; axis 22−6​=−2.x=2，x=−6；对称轴 22−6​=−2。

quiz.q: Write y=x2−2x−15 in factored form and find the vertex.把 y=x2−2x−15 写成交点式，并求顶点。
quiz.hint: Two numbers multiplying to −15, adding to −2.乘积 −15、和为 −2 的两个数。
quiz.ans: y=(x−5)(x+3); vertex (1,−16)y=(x−5)(x+3)；顶点 (1,−16)
quiz.why: (x−5)(x+3); axis x=1; y=(1−5)(1+3)=−16.(x−5)(x+3)；对称轴 x=1；y=(1−5)(1+3)=−16。

quiz.q: A punter at BC Place kicks a football from the ground, and it lands 50 m away. A video review shows the ball was 4.5 m high when it was 5 m downfield. (a) Model the flight as a parabola and find its maximum height. (b) A 10 m-high stadium light hangs directly in the flight path 40 m from the kicker. Does the ball clear it? Justify your answer with numbers.BC Place 球场上，踢球手把橄榄球从地面踢出，球落在 50 m 外。视频回放显示球飞到 5 m 远处时高 4.5 m。(a) 把飞行轨迹建成抛物线，求最大高度。(b) 在离踢球手 40 m 的飞行路径上正好挂着一盏 10 m 高的球场灯。球能越过它吗？请用数据说明理由。
quiz.hint: Ground at x=0 and x=50 gives y=ax(x−50); use (5,4.5) for a. The maximum is on the axis x=25.地面高度出现在 x=0 和 x=50，设 y=ax(x−50)，用 (5,4.5) 求 a。最大值在对称轴 x=25 上。
quiz.ans: y=−0.02x(x−50); maximum 12.5 m at x=25; at x=40 the ball is 8 m high, so it does not clear the 10 m lighty=−0.02x(x−50)；最大高度 12.5 m（在 x=25 处）；x=40 处球高 8 m，越不过 10 m 的灯
quiz.why: Zeros at 0 and 50: y=ax(x−50). With (5,4.5): 4.5=a(5)(−45)=−225a, so a=−0.02.零点在 0 和 50：y=ax(x−50)。代入 (5,4.5)：4.5=a(5)(−45)=−225a，得 a=−0.02。
